artifacts.summary: Implementation plan with 2 phases to remove redundant title field from task.md jq templates
Execution summary for task 694 title derivation fix

completion_data.completion_summary: Removed redundant 'title': $desc from the jq task-creation template and fixed the Expand mode comment across all three copies of task.md (nvim commands, extension core, and cslib). New tasks now rely on generate-todo.sh's project_name fallback for title derivation.

memory_candidates.content: When a task.md jq template sets 'title': $desc (same value as description), task titles in TODO.md will display as the full multi-sentence description instead of a concise derived title. The generate-todo.sh fallback derives clean titles from project_name (replace underscores with spaces, capitalize first letter) when the title field is absent. Fix: remove the 'title' field from jq templates entirely and rely on the fallback.
